verdict_summary: The November 15, 2026 frozen snapshot is a PARTIAL_MATCH (extended superset) with the earlier November 14, 2026 snapshot. For all 2,478 shared NSE observations and all 2,466 shared Yahoo observations, close prices are 100.0% numerically identical with zero drift. However, exact equivalence is not established because the date sets differ (Nov 15 requested start was 2016-11-01 adding 10 earlier trading days), on 2016-11-16 the NSE Indices provider endpoint returned an observation absent in the Nov 14 snapshot, and earlier Nov 14 raw OHLCV files were not persisted independently.

earlier_snapshot.provenance_limitation: Full OHLCV (open, high, low, volume) was not persisted as separate CSVs in Nov 14 audit; only close prices exist in price_reconciliation.csv.

endpoint_coverage_change_20161116.finding: The endpoint behavior changed between retrievals: 2016-11-16 was returned by NSE Indices on Nov 15 but was omitted on Nov 14.

verdict_criteria_evaluation.evaluation_detail: EXACT_MATCH fails because date sets differ (10 extra dates in Nov 15) and 2016-11-16 presence differs on NSE. COUNT_ONLY_MATCH fails because record-level prices on overlapping dates match with 100% precision rather than merely agreeing in total count. NOT_VERIFIABLE is rejected because historical close prices are fully preserved in price_reconciliation.csv and verifiable. PARTIAL_MATCH is confirmed: an exact subset/superset match with perfect price consistency across all overlapping observations.
